description: This PHP class 'Config' extends 'BaseConfig' and manages configuration settings for HTML format rendering within a documentation tool. It provides methods to retrieve and prepare URLs, toggle display options (like search, date, navigation links), and access analytics and branding parameters.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A configuration handler class for HTML output in the documentation system, extending 'BaseConfig' to include specific settings such as URL preparation, analytics, and display options.

methods.name: prepareGithubUrl
methods.description: Converts a given URL to HTTPS and constructs a 'basepath' for GitHub links.

methods.name: getEditOn
methods.description: Returns the URL configuration for editing pages, processing 'edit_on' and 'edit_on_github' settings.

methods.name: hasSearch
methods.description: Checks if search functionality is enabled.

methods.name: showDateModified
methods.description: Checks if the modification date should be displayed.

methods.name: showPreviousNextLinks
methods.description: Checks if previous/next navigation links should be shown.

methods.name: showCodeToggle
methods.description: Checks if code toggle buttons should be displayed.

methods.name: hasAutomaticTableOfContents
methods.description: Checks if automatic table of contents is enabled.

methods.name: hasGoogleAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Google Analytics is configured.

methods.name: getGoogleAnalyticsId
methods.description: Retrieves the Google Analytics ID.

methods.name: hasPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Checks if a Plausible analytics domain is set.

methods.name: getPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the Plausible analytics domain.

methods.name: hasPiwikAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Piwik analytics is configured.

methods.name: getPiwikAnalyticsId
methods.description: Retrieves the Piwik Analytics ID.

methods.name: getPiwikAnalyticsUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the Piwik analytics URL.

methods.name: hasPoweredBy
methods.description: Checks if 'Powered By' information is configured.

methods.name: getPoweredBy
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Powered By' information.

methods.name: hasTwitterHandles
methods.description: Checks if Twitter handles are configured.

methods.name: getTwitterHandles
methods.description: Retrieves Twitter handles.

methods.name: hasLinks
methods.description: Checks if external links are configured.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves external links configuration.

methods.name: hasRepository
methods.description: Checks if a repository link is configured.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Retrieves the repository URL.

methods.name: hasButtons
methods.description: Checks if custom buttons are configured.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Retrieves button configurations.

methods.name: hasLandingPage
methods.description: Checks if a landing page is enabled.

methods.name: hasBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Checks if breadcrumbs navigation is enabled.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbsSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the separator used in breadcrumbs.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the theme setting.

methods.name: hasThemeVariant
methods.description: Checks if a theme variant is set.

methods.name: getThemeVariant
methods.description: Retrieves the theme variant setting.
